change: Keep Rust table-vector resizing outside the VM frame protocol. It only changes external storage and accounting; it cannot collect, park, raise a VM error or move the VM stack. Pending frame state and budget charges stay in the native context.
architecture: The switch to the Nupp runtime and handler-derived compilation through partial evaluation is decided. This is an interpreter helper change, with no guest.nupp changes. Performance bars govern tier replacement, not architecture adoption.

artifacts.idea: External table vector resizing does not publish or reload VM state. It cannot collect, park, raise a VM error or move the VM stack.

protocol.comparison: nupp bench --against, interleaved paired fresh processes, identical benchmark sources, 2% margin, checksums required
protocol.isolation: No builds or tests overlapped any timed comparison. Original N09 and Rust control bundles were preserved.
protocol.rebuildEquivalence: Final rebuild differs from the interpreter measurement binary only in two Rust source-location line numbers in __DATA_CONST,__const (and derived UUID/signature metadata) after a comment was expanded. All instruction bytes, section sizes and addresses match; JIT-on timing uses the final rebuilt binary. Exact hashes and changed source locations are recorded.
